title: Disappointed
text:
Let me start with the positive comment- the quality of the items was great. The box is cute and my cat enjoyed the items.
I gave it two stars because the items in the pack were were Christmas themed and arrived months after the holiday. The contents were not a surprise like I expected. They were the same items available for quite awhile on resale platforms.
I’m keeping my subscription and will see how the spring box goes.
label: negative
